mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent.mining_agent_conversation_msg (msg_id, conversation_id, sender_type, sender_id, msg_type, msg_content, file_meta) VALUES (#{msgId}, #{conversationId}, #{senderType}, #{senderId}, #{msgType}, #{msgContent}, #{fileMeta}::jsonb)
mapper.select: SELECT msg_id, conversation_id, sender_type, sender_id, msg_type, msg_content, file_meta, send_time, is_deleted FROM agent.mining_agent_conversation_msg WHERE msg_id = #{msgId} AND is_deleted = FALSE

SELECT msg_id, conversation_id, sender_type, sender_id, msg_type, msg_content, file_meta, send_time, is_deleted FROM agent.mining_agent_conversation_msg WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY send_time ASC

SELECT msg_id, conversation_id, sender_type, sender_id, msg_type, msg_content, file_meta, send_time, is_deleted FROM agent.mining_agent_conversation_msg WHERE sender_id = #{senderId} AND msg_type = #{msgType} AND is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY send_time DESC

SELECT msg_id, conversation_id, sender_type, sender_id, msg_type, msg_content, file_meta, send_time, is_deleted FROM agent.mining_agent_conversation_msg WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY send_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
